Extract og:title, og:description, and og:image from Open Graph meta tags

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<html><head><title>Fallback Title</title><meta property=\"og:title\" content=\"OG Title\"><meta property=\"og:description\" content=\"OG description text.\"><meta property=\"og:image\" content=\"https://example.com/image.jpg\"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
